mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) of at least 0.1% over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.1% over the past 3 months, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it indicates accelerating inflation, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) indicates a weakening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of a broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% from their 3-month moving averages, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.0%, the Federal Reserve is likely to adopt an accommodative monetary policy, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 7.0%, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index 2017=100) over the past month signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 500.0 (thousands of units) over the past month indicates a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 500.0, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) of at least 0.1% over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.1% over the past 3 months, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) of at least 0.1% over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.1% over the past 3 months, or the rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
